records.label: Muscular build
records.visual_function: Create a strong, trained physique whose muscle groups support posture, motion, and weight as connected anatomical volumes.
records.prompt: Give the subject a muscular trained build with a broad load-bearing torso, developed shoulders and limbs, clear joint transitions, and muscle volumes that follow the pose and remain proportional to the head and frame.
invariants: major muscle groups follow the skeleton and action line
the torso, neck, shoulders, and limbs share one believable scale
strength remains readable in both relaxed and active poses
misreadings_to_avoid: random muscle grooves disconnected from movement
tiny head caused by uncontrolled torso enlargement

records.label: Average build
records.visual_function: Keep the subject's frame ordinary in proportion, so identity reads through the other declared choices while the physique stays a neutral ground.
records.prompt: Give the subject an average, untrained build: natural proportions, soft muscle definition, an even distribution of mass across shoulders, torso and limbs, and a silhouette that stays legible at any scale while holding to the middle of the range.
invariants: proportions stay within ordinary ranges for the chosen domain
mass stays evenly distributed across the shoulders, torso and limbs
the silhouette reads neutral under both relaxed and active poses
misreadings_to_avoid: drift toward trained shoulders or torso
gaunt or emaciated framing from a neutral prompt

records.label: Lithe build
records.visual_function: Create a slender, flexible physique whose length and narrowness support quick, low-mass motion, with reach and articulation carrying the read.
records.prompt: Give the subject a lithe build: narrow shoulders and torso, long proportional limbs, a light surface with tendon and joint definition close to the skin, and a silhouette that reads quick and flexible in every pose.
invariants: limb length and torso narrowness stay consistent across poses
the frame reads light and healthy, with muscle present at low volume
movement reads flexible and resilient at full extension
misreadings_to_avoid: muscular drift from generic anatomy defaults
childlike proportions when age is not intended
